comments.text: 🌏 This Dhaka travel documentary reveals a side of Bangladesh’s capital that most tourists never see, hidden behind crowded streets, colorful rickshaws, and modern buildings. 🇧🇩 Which story surprised you most—the lives of garment workers, families searching for a new beginning, or the reality behind Dhaka’s rapid growth? Share your opinion below and tell us whether cities like Dhaka can grow without leaving millions of people behind. 👍 Like the video and subscribe for more powerful travel documentaries about the world’s most misunderstood places. #Dhaka #Bangladesh #TravelDocumentary #DhakaDocumentary #HiddenDhaka
